_comment: Requêtes d'évaluation du retrieval et de la RQ3, rédigées à la main AVANT de regarder les cas de la table. 'category' = technique ATLAS de l'attaque décrite (sert au bonus α / filtre) ; 'expected' = techniques dont un cas remonté compte comme pertinent ; 'in_corpus' = la table contient au moins un cas de ces techniques. Les requêtes hors corpus servent à calibrer θ : le système doit y signaler une couverture insuffisante.

queries.name: indirect_web_page
queries.attack_summary: A web page retrieved by the assistant contains hidden instructions that make it send the user's conversation to an attacker-controlled URL.

queries.name: indirect_email
queries.attack_summary: An email assistant processes an incoming message containing instructions that make it forward the user's contacts to the sender.

queries.name: indirect_document
queries.attack_summary: A shared document summarized by the model contains embedded commands that change the summary shown to the user.

queries.name: direct_override
queries.attack_summary: The user types instructions telling the chatbot to ignore its previous instructions and follow new ones instead.

queries.name: direct_goal_hijack
queries.attack_summary: A crafted input hijacks the original task of an LLM application so that it performs the attacker's task instead.

queries.name: triggered_keyword
queries.attack_summary: An injected instruction stays dormant and only activates when a specific keyword later appears in the conversation.

queries.name: triggered_memory
queries.attack_summary: An injection stored in the assistant's long-term memory re-infects the model when a later session reads that memory.

queries.name: jailbreak_roleplay
queries.attack_summary: The attacker asks the model to role-play a fictional character without rules, making it produce content its safety training should refuse.

queries.name: jailbreak_devmode
queries.attack_summary: The prompt asks the model to simulate an unrestricted developer mode in which content filters do not apply.

queries.name: jailbreak_encoding
queries.attack_summary: A harmful request is encoded in Base64 so that the input filter does not recognize it and the model decodes and answers it.

queries.name: public_forum_infiltration
queries.attack_summary: The attacker publishes instructions on a public forum that an LLM-integrated search application later reads and obeys.

queries.name: public_repo_comments
queries.attack_summary: Malicious comments placed in a public code repository steer the suggestions of a code completion assistant.

queries.name: training_data_poisoning
queries.attack_summary: The attacker inserts crafted samples into the fine-tuning dataset so that the model learns attacker-chosen behavior.

queries.name: system_prompt_extraction
queries.attack_summary: The user asks the chatbot to repeat everything above this message, and the model reveals its hidden system prompt.

queries.name: membership_inference
queries.attack_summary: The attacker queries the model to determine whether a specific person's record was part of its training data.

queries.name: training_data_extraction
queries.attack_summary: Repeated prompting makes the model reproduce memorized personal data verbatim from its training set.

queries.name: model_extraction
queries.attack_summary: The attacker sends many API queries and trains a copy of the model from its answers to steal its functionality.

queries.name: adversarial_image
queries.attack_summary: Imperceptible pixel perturbations make an image classifier label a stop sign as a speed limit sign.
